description:
## Goal

Make `CallSiteMap` and `CallSiteTargetsMap` exact value stores for the live `CallSiteSummary`/`CallSiteTargets` ledger facts. When the last publisher withdraws a callsite fact, remove its stored resolution so absence is bottom and a later `Unresolved` publication cannot inherit a stale `Resolved` answer.

## Signal

- A red World test publishes resolved summary and targets through one `AnalyzeActivation` conclusion, concludes while omitting both, and proves both facts are absent and `callsite_resolution`, `callsite_summary`, `callsite_target_resolution`, and `callsite_targets` all return `None`.
- The same test re-publishes `Unresolved` and proves both resolution accessors return `Unresolved`, both resolved accessors return `None`, and the remint wakes/moves readers as a fresh replacing fact.
- Artifact helpers no longer construct store-without-ledger state; they either publish matching facts or accept isolated semantic values directly.
- Focused compiler2 tests and corpus/lib/matrix/CLI gates pass; a census finds zero reads of a callsite map entry whose corresponding fact is absent.

## Strategy

- Add key removal to both maps and, after `work_graph.complete`, consume its `FactChange` entries whose `new_revision` is `None` to prune matching store keys. Keep pruning at the single ledger-completion boundary, not scattered reader gates.
- Cover multi-publisher behavior: prune only on actual final retraction, never when one publisher withdraws but the fact remains.
- Delete or update `artifact.rs:1252-1260` and semantic-fixpoint wording that claim the stale split or defer it to dead fz-kdt.69.3.
- Keep Unresolved-as-bottom join behavior only within a live fact epoch; retraction starts a fresh epoch.

No store-outlives-ledger contract, no per-consumer `has_fact` shims, no stale resolved answer surviving retraction, and no test-only impossible World state.
title: Prune callsite semantic stores when their facts retract
